tokens.styling: Tailwind v4 utility classes + the app's design tokens; extract repeated clusters to function components
tokens.accent: one theme accent + neutral ramp; AA contrast; no purple-gradient default
tokens.icons: always the core_components <.icon name="hero-..."> component; never Heroicons modules

components.name: input
components.when_to_use: every form field; drives errors + labels

components.name: button
components.when_to_use: one primary action per view; secondary/tertiary otherwise

components.name: app layout
components.when_to_use: wrap every LiveView template's inner content

components.name: form
components.when_to_use: always via to_form/2; give it a unique DOM id

rules: Reach for an existing core_components tag before hand-rolling HEEx/Tailwind.
Begin every LiveView template with <Layouts.app flash={@flash} ...>; never call <.flash_group> outside layouts.ex.
Forms are always driven by a to_form/2 assign and the <.input> component; never access a changeset in the template.
Use LiveView streams for collections (flat memory); set phx-update="stream" + a DOM id on the parent and each child.

Petal Components or daisyUI (both HEEx, Tailwind v4) are the sanctioned richer libraries when core_components is insufficient; hand-write bespoke components for a unique look rather than pulling a JSX generator (HEEx is not JSX).
Follow the ui-ux-foundations rubric: hierarchy, AA contrast, visible focus, and none of the AI-slop tells.
